We’re fighting to earn every vote — and that means we need to air our ads
consistently in all of Georgia’s 159 counties before November. But right
now we don’t have the resources we need to do that.

name: John Fetterman
subject: I’M BACK
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
You gotta check out this crowd.
#
Hi Derek. It’s John Fetterman, reporting live from beautiful Erie, PA.
I *just* got off the stage at our first BIG rally of the General Election.
I’M BACK!
[**_Before I ask you to make a donation of any amount to support our campaign before our August mid-month deadline,_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-2?refcode=em20220812-6841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG) will you just TAKE A LOOK AT THIS CROWD! 🥰
(Let’s be honest, Dr. Oz couldn’t get this many people in Erie even if he was handing out $50 bills.)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-2?refcode=em20220812-6841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG)
All jokes aside, it was so incredible to be in Erie. This county has my whole heart. ❤️
I just can’t say enough how grateful I am to be out here tonight. The stroke I suffered a few months ago was a very grave situation. If it had happened at a different time or in a different place, (or if Gisele hadn’t been with me) I probably wouldn't be here.
That’s why I’m so grateful. Grateful not only to be alive after that, but also grateful that we’re building a successful campaign alongside you, Derek. 🙏
**I’m feeling great, better than I have in years. I’m back + I’m ready to win this seat in November, Derek.**
[**_Will you make a donation of any amount to our campaign before I hit the road back to Braddock from Erie? Even $10, $5, or $3 has a direct and immediate impact on my chances to beat Dr. Oz and win Pennsylvania._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-2?refcode=em20220812-6841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-2?refcode=em20220812-6841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG)**
Look, this is gonna be a tough race. We’re up against Dr. Oz, aka Doc Hollywood aka my Trump-endorsed opponent, who is self-funding his campaign with his own personal million$.
But Pennsylvania is our home. And it’s worth fighting for.
So here’s my message to Dr. Oz: **Save your money. Pennsylvania is not for sale.**
It’s time to get to work. 💯
Thank you for *everything*.
— John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
P.S. Gisele wants me to remind you that we have a mid-month fundraising deadline coming up on Monday. 🙄 **_[If you’re in a place to do so, can you make a contribution of any amount today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220812-2?refcode=em20220812-6841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG)_**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220812-6841-footer&t=1&refcode2=6841_434096_QcD4yG&akid=6841%2E434096%2EQcD4yG)**
---
[](https://www.facebook.com/JohnFettermanPA/) | [](https://twitter.com/johnfetterman) | [](https://www.instagram.com/johnfetterman/)
Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.

We’re pleased that our legal pressure forced the partial release of
warrant materials about the Biden administration’s political raid on
the home of former President Trump. We expect and demand the
underlying warrant affidavit and other materials be immediately
disclosed.

Due to multiple organizations filing to unseal the warrant, Judge

the immediate release of those documents.”

Our August 9 motion stated:

Judicial Watch is investigating the potential politicization of the
Federal Bureau of Investigation and the U.S. Department of Justice and
whether the FBI and the Justice Department are abusing their law
enforcement powers to harass a likely future political opponent of
President Biden.

***
The public has an urgent and substantial interest in understanding the
predicate for the execution of the unprecedented search warrant of the
private residence of a former president and likely future political
opponent.... [N]o official explanation or information has been
released about the search. As of the filing of this motion, the public
record consists solely of speculation and inuendo. In short, the
historical presumption of access to warrant materials vastly outweighs
any interest the government may have in keeping the materials under
seal.

***
Given the political context, and the highly unusual action of
executing a search warrant at the residence of a former President and
likely future political opponent, it is essential that the public
understands as soon as possible the basis for the government’s
action. Any government interest in securing the identities of
witnesses and confidential sources, if any, may be addressed by
appropriate redactions from the search warrant affidavit.

The U.S. Constitution and federal law give unreviewable authority to
President Trump to take whatever records he wishes at the end of his
presidency. The Biden administration’s dishonest depiction of
personal records of President Trump it illicitly seized during the
raid as “classified” is further demonstration that the raid was a
brazen act of raw political abuse.

JUDICIAL WATCH SUES FOR ‘RUSSIA HOAX’ RECORDS TRUMP ORDERED
RELEASED

The Obama-Biden administrations and Deep State spying on Trump and his

We sued the Department of Justice for records President Trump ordered
declassified and released the day before he left office. The records
relate to “Crossfire Hurricane,” the controversial spy operation
against President Trump, his 2016 presidential campaign, and other
Trump associates, and have yet to be made public by the Biden

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27852&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb3NzZmlyZS1odXJyaWNhbmUtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjY0L10oTm8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=.
1:22-cv-02264)).

We filed suit against the DOJ after it failed to respond to a February
17, 2022, FOIA request for:

All records regarding the Federal Bureau of Investigation’s
Crossfire Hurricane investigation that were provided to the White
House by the Department of Justice on or about December 30, 2020. For
purposes of clarification, the records sought are those described in a
January 19, 2021 Presidential Memorandum
(see
https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27853&F=T&
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27812&F=T&]).

All records of communication between any official or employee of the
Department of Justice and any official or employee of any other
branch, department, agency, or office of the federal government
regarding the declassification and release of the records described in
part one of this request.

Trump’s memo authorized the declassification and release of the
records:

By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States of America, I hereby direct the following:

Section 1. Declassification and Release. At my request, on December
30, 2020, the Department of Justice provided the White House with a
binder of materials related to the Federal Bureau of Investigation’s
Crossfire Hurricane investigation. Portions of the documents in the
binder have remained classified and have not been released to the
Congress or the public. I requested the documents so that a
declassification review could be performed and so I could determine to
what extent materials in the binder should be released in unclassified
form.

I determined that the materials in that binder should be declassified
to the maximum extent possible. In response, and as part of the
iterative process of the declassification review, under a cover letter
dated January 17, 2021, the Federal Bureau of Investigation noted its
continuing objection to any further declassification of the materials
in the binder and also, on the basis of a review that included
Intelligence Community equities, identified the passages that it
believed it was most crucial to keep from public disclosure. I have
determined to accept the redactions proposed for continued
classification by the FBI in that January 17 submission.

I hereby declassify the remaining materials in the binder. This is
my final determination under the declassification review and I have
directed the Attorney General to implement the redactions proposed in
the FBI’s January 17 submission and return to the White House an
appropriately redacted copy.

My decision to declassify materials within the binder is subject to
the limits identified above and does not extend to materials that must
be protected from disclosure pursuant to orders of the Foreign
Intelligence Surveillance Court and does not require the disclosure of
certain personally identifiable information or any other materials
that must be protected from disclosure under applicable law.
Accordingly, at my direction, the Attorney General has conducted an
appropriate review to ensure that materials provided in the binder may
be disclosed by the White House in accordance with applicable law.

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27854&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbmV4YW1pbmVyLmNvbS9yZXN0b3JpbmctYW1lcmljYS9wYXRyaW90aXNtLXVuaXR5L2NyaXRpY2FsLXJhY2UtdGhlb3J5LWlzLWEtdGhyZWF0LXRvLW91ci1uYXRpb25hbC1zZWN1cml0eV1wdWJsaXNoZWQ/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=

The U.S. military is being attacked from within. But instead of rifles

The latest target is the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, which

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27856&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbmV4YW1pbmVyLmNvbS90YWcvY3JpdGljYWwtcmFjZS10aGVvcnk/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=],

Marxist theory that stokes racial separatism.

As a result of two Freedom of Information Act lawsuits against the

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59765&L=27536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY3J0LXByb3BhZ2FuZGEtYXQtd2VzdC1wb2ludC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=]
of more
than 600 pages of PowerPoint slides, handouts, and other curricula
used to educate West Point cadets on topics such as “modern day
slavery in the USA.”

The documents from West Point reveal an assault on cadets in the form
of race-based shaming that paints one race as an oppressor and another
as the victim. In one presentation, for example, titled “‘Race and
the Invisible Hand’: How White Networks Exclude Black Men from
Blue-Collar Jobs,” West Point cadets were taught that white people
are malicious oppressors. The academy’s training materials also
described whiteness as “a standpoint or place from which white
people look at themselves and the rest of society.”

Cadets were directed to “consider how the contemporary issues that
relate to race, gender, and sexuality apply to the army and how they
impact the army officer.” The materials went on to explain that
CRT’s concepts “are essential for future military officers to
understand and fully absorb.” And, if that’s not enough, students
learned the fundamentals of feminist theory and queer theory in a
three-credit social sciences class titled “The Politics of Race,

Unfortunately, the Biden administration has made critical race theory a primary governing principle. Indeed, Gen. Darryl Williams, the West Point superintendent responsible for the CRT abuse of the cadets in his care, was given a fourth star by Biden and PROMOTED [=] to commander of U.S. Army Europe and Africa. Congress can end this insanity, but the Democratic-controlled congress is set to push back on any attempts to restrict CRT and its inclusion in our military’s education programs. It’s no wonder, then, that the U.S. Army is projected to fall 10,000 SOLDIERS SHORT THIS FISCAL YEAR [=]. Why would American patriots join today’s Army, which seems too often to oppose fundamental American values? Thankfully, the abuse at West Point is not going unnoticed. West Point graduates recently SIGNED [=] a letter objecting to the teaching of radical agendas at the academy. The letter points out that by teaching CRT and hosting progressive guest speakers, West Point violated U.S. Army regulations by permitting political activism on campus. And, as the graduates argued, CRT indoctrination at West Point does more harm than good by placing race at the forefront of U.S. military education. The military has long sought to embody Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s DREAM [] that people “not be judged by the color of their skin, but by the content of their character” through its commitment to character and common purpose. In fact, the military uniform is a great equalizer that has long united people regardless of color, class, gender, and religion. But by sowing racial divisions between cadets, CRT fosters resentment and anger instead of the unity essential for an effective fighting force. Studies show that bonds of unity play a significant role on the front lines. Nearly all soldiers report a “fused” identity with their battalions akin to the fusion between themselves and their own family members, according to a University of Oxford STUDY []. When asked which group they felt most fused to, 45% of soldiers chose their own battalions over their families. Manufacturing political and racial tensions between cadets in training could create disastrous consequences for battalion cohesion and Army leadership down the road — which, from our enemies’ perspective, could be the point. The ideological attack on West Point cadets (and the woke leadership in our military’s other ACADEMIES [=]) must stop. Such blatantly racist, anti-American propaganda not only threatens to radicalize the next generation of U.S. Army leadership, but it undermines the purpose of our military: to identify, confront, and destroy the enemy. If critical race theory persists in the training of future officers, they will see the enemy as their fellow American. LEFTIST ATTACK ON HUNGARY’S PRIME MINISTER VIKTOR ORBAN As we endure the brazen onslaught of leftist thinking in the United States, it is reassuring to see that a foreign country, in an unlikely location, is celebrating freedom and Christian, pro-family values. Chris Farrell, our director of investigations and research, HAS WRITTEN [] about this nation, Hungary, for The Washington Times. The left hates that a popular, conservative government prospers in the heart of central Europe. When that country cheerfully maintains its sovereignty and distinct national identity while belonging to the European Union and NATO, elites bristle. Making things worse, the country self-identifies as a Christian, pro-family nation, and aided more than 700,000 refugees fleeing war-torn Ukraine. Hungary and the reelected Prime Minister Viktor Orban are in the crosshairs of attack for daring to be Hungarian. “How dare they?” chuff anointed arbiters of European moral norms, legal debate and wealth redistribution. “Journalists” and opinion leaders are quick to join in slinging accusations of various “-isms,” phobias and mind-reading analyses. Adding to the indignation of the post-Western, globalists-in-charge is that Mr. Orban was a keynote speaker at the Conservative Political Action Conference in Dallas last week. Mr. Orban gave his fearless, inspiring speech to a packed house, well-received with standing ovations. Mr. Orban told the Texas crowd that Hungary was the “Lone Star State of Europe,” while engaging in brutal truth-telling that Americans almost never hear: “If somebody has doubts whether progressive liberals and communists are the same, just ask us, Hungarians. We fought them both, and I can tell you: They are the same.” “Obama ... tried to force us to change the Fundamental law of Hungary, and delete Christian and national values from it. Do you get it? The leading power of the free world wanted to force us to change our constitution according to a globalist liberal concept. How bizarre!” “... Today’s progressives ... separate Western Civilization from its Christian roots once again. They are crossing a line that should never be crossed. If you separate Western Civilization from its Judeo-Christian heritage, the worst things in history happen.” “To sum up: The mother is a woman, the father is a man, and leave our kids alone. Full stop! End of discussion!” In the corridors of Brussels and leftist editorial Zoom meetings, the same objective was made clear: “Mr. Orban and his message must be stopped!” But Mr. Orban predicted their reactions: “I can already see tomorrow’s headlines: ‘Far-right European racist and antisemite strongman, the Trojan horse of Putin, holds speech at conservative conference.’” Mr. Orban was correct, because the “go-to” technique to silence anyone making the left nervous is “the smear,” straight out of the Saul Alinsky “Rules for Radicals,” and it often works. Before CPAC, Mr. Orban made an annual address to the Hungarian minority in Romania. The Washington Post and their ilk will not give you Mr. Orban’s full quote with context, too busy saving keystrokes so they can write “Nazi” and “authoritarian” while advocating for the EU to withhold funds from Hungary. Here is what Mr. Orban actually said: “The internationalist left employs a feint, an ideological ruse: The claim ... that Europe by its very nature is populated by peoples of mixed race. This is a historical and semantic sleight of hand, because it conflates two different things. There is a world in which European peoples are mixed together with those arriving from outside Europe. Now that is a mixed-race world. And there is our world, where people from within Europe mix with one another, move around, work and relocate. So, for example, in the Carpathian Basin we are not mixed-race: We are simply a mixture of peoples living in our own European homeland. And, given a favorable alignment of stars and a following wind, these peoples merge together in a kind of Hungaro-Pannonian sauce, creating their own new European culture. This is why we have always fought: we are willing to mix with one another, but we do not want to become peoples of mixed-race. This is why we fought at Nandorfehervar/Belgrade, this is why we stopped the Turks at Vienna, and ... in still older times — the French stopped the Arabs at Poitiers.” Here is the essence of Mr. Orban’s statement: Europeans are from Europe; Turks and Arabs are from their own homelands. Fundamentally, that’s it. Various peoples are indigenous to their regions with distinct identities, cultures, history, languages, religions. Mr. Orban was simply advocating for the Magyar people. They are allowed to have a home and identity and hand down their heritage through generations. France and Germany are free to make their own decisions and value their own identity, culture, history, language and religion — or not. Self-determination is the freedom to choose without external compulsion — the power of a nation to decide how it will be governed without the influence of another country. The United Nations Charter guarantees the right to self-determination in the framework of international law and diplomacy. Now is the time to consider how a country like Hungary can make choices to advance its own interests — based on faith, family, history, culture and tradition — without the threat of compulsion or intimidation, or subjection to false claims of racism and bigotry as a sleazy political trick. body:
https://www.catherineforcongress.com [https://www.catherineforcongress.com]
EARLY VOTING STARTS TODAY!
Have you made your plan to vote? The Catherine for Congress team wants you to be aware of all the great opportunities to get out and vote in this summer primary. You can vote by mail (absentee), vote early, or vote on Election Day! Here’s some great tips to help remind you to GET OUT and VOTE by August 23rd!
VOTE BY ABSENTEE
Some of our families have voted by absentee since they’re away at the end of the month before school starts back up, so they applied online and already received their absentee. If you think you’ll be away on August 23rd or unable to vote early, voting by absentee is a great way to make sure your voice is still heard in this critical election.
You’ll now need to apply for an absentee ballot in person. Just head over to the County Board of Elections office at 25 Quarropas Street, White Plains, NY 10601 and tell them you’d like to vote by absentee. You’ll fill out a form and then be handed your ballot right there in person!
VOTE EARLY
Most of us have scheduled to go vote at an early voting location and even created a calendar event in our calendars. Whether you need a sticky note on the frig or set an alarm, go ahead and stop what you’re doing right now and MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE EARLY.
Where can I EARLY vote?
Mamaroneck Town Center, 740 W. Boston Post Road, Mamaroneck, NY 10543
Rye Brook Firehouse, 940 King Street, Rye Brook, NY 10573
Eastchester Public Library, 11 Oakridge Place, Eastchester, NY 10709
Dobbs Ferry Village Hall, 112 Main Street, Dobbs Ferry, NY 10522
Greenburgh Town Hall, 177 Hillside Avenue, White Plains, NY 10607
St. Gregory The Great Church, 215 Halstead Avenue, Harrison, NY 10528
Doles Center, 250 S. 6th Avenue, Mt. Vernon, NY 10550
Mt. Vernon City Hall, 1 Roosevelt Square, Mt. Vernon, NY 10550
New Rochelle City Hall Annex, 90 Beaufort Place, 90 Beaufort Place, New Rochelle NY 10801
New Rochelle United Methodist Church, 1200 North Avenue, New Rochelle, NY 10804
Westchester County Board of Elections, 25 Quarropas Street, White Plains, NY 10601
Grinton I. Will Library, 1500 Central Park Avenue, Yonkers, NY 10710
Nodine Hill Community Center, 140 Fillmore Street, Yonkers, NY 10701
Riverfront Library, One Larkin Center, Yonkers, NY 10701
When can I EARLY vote?
Saturday, Aug. 13, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.
Sunday, Aug. 14, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.
Monday, Aug. 15, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.
Tuesday, Aug. 16, 2022 from noon until 8 p.m.
Wednesday, Aug. 17, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.
Thursday, Aug. 18, 2022 from noon until 8 p.m.
Friday, Aug. 19, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.
Saturday, Aug. 20, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.
Sunday, Aug. 21, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.
VOTE ON ELECTION DAY
Polls will be open on Tuesday, August 23rd from 6am - 9pm. You can find your local polling location by clicking this website. [https://citizenparticipation.westchestergov.com/find-polling-place] If you’re unable to vote early or by absentee, this is the last day you’ll have to turn out and vote!
We hope you all will join us in casting your vote for Catherine. She is the most experienced candidate in this race who will fight for us, vote on our behalf, and be transparent in her service to you. We know she’ll do that because it’s what she’s always done.
NOW GO VOTE!
Other Important Dates for this Summer Primary
Visit our website for more voting information. [https://www.catherineforcongress.com/vote]
Monday, August 22: Last Day to apply for an Absentee Ballot in person at your nearest Board of Elections [https://www.elections.ny.gov/CountyBoards.html]
Tuesday August 23: Election Day, find your polling location [https://citizenparticipation.westchestergov.com/find-polling-place] .
Sign up to Volunteer [https://www.mobilize.us/catherineforcongress/] Donate TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/catherineforcongress]
Learn more by visiting Catherine’s website, or follow her on Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/CatherineForCongress] , Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/catherineny16/] , or Twitter [https://twitter.com/catherineNY16] .

No images? [Click here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-e-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-o/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-r/)
# Update from the Campaign Trail 8/12/22
Good evening,Team Chabot has been working hard and traveling throughout the district. This week, Congressman Chabot has been hard at work meeting voters at events across Ohio's 1st Congressional District. At the same time, he has been sounding the alarm about the disastrous "Inflation Reduction Act" which raises taxes, creates an IRS on steroids, and spends billions of dollars on Green New Deal initiatives. **_Congressman Chabot on the Trail_** _Congressman Chabot Knocking Doors_ Congressman Chabot has been working hard and bringing his message of lowering inflation, bringing down gas prices, and making sure we have safe neighborhoods directly to voters' doors. The Congressman has recently been out knocking doors in Carthage, Westwood, Price Hill, Norwood and other local neighborhoods! Keep an eye out for Congressman Chabot and his team in your neighborhood soon! _St. Bernard German Luau_ Last weekend, Congressman Chabot attended the St. Bernard German Luau. It was great to see people out enjoying their community. We made sure to grab some kettle corn for the road! _Lebanon Blues Festival_ The annual Lebanon Blues Festival is always one of the best events in OH-01. Congressman Chabot made sure to spend some time with some of the folks who were out enjoying the festival! **_Congressman Chabot in Cincinnati Enquirer: "CHIPS Act will help create thousands of jobs in Ohio in the immediate future"_**The CHIPs Act was officially signed into law this week, marking a major victory for semiconductor development in Ohio. Read Congressman Chabot's op-ed in the Enquirer from last week to learn more!_" If we learned anything during the early days of the pandemic, it was that America can no longer afford to rely on other nations for products and supplies critical to our economy and our national security."_Read Congressman Chabot's full op-ed in the Cincinnati Enquirer at the link [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-y/). _This Week 's Blog - "The IRS is Coming for YOU_ _"_ This week's blog post is about the so-called "Inflation Reduction Act" and the wide range of negative effects it will have on our country:_" Well, just because you slap a label on something, doesn't mean that's what you're going to get. And that's exactly what the Democrats in Congress are doing this week. Passing a bill, without one Republican vote, called the "Inflation Reduction Act", which isn't going to do anything of the kind. It's a cynical effort to mislead the public and pass a wish list of radical, left-wing policies."_Read the blog post [here](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-j/). Have a great weekend.Yours truly,John GomezCampaign Manager - Chabot for Congress [Donate](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-t/) [Get a Yard Sign](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-i/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-d/) [](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-h/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-k/)[](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-l-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-u/) [ Share ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-fb-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-b/) [ Tweet ](https://start.rightmailer.net/t/r-tw-tyuykrx-kujkulhluu-n/) [ Forward ](https://stevechabotforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/r-kujkulhluu-961825B2-tyuykrx-l-p) | Chabot for Congress, P.O. Team,
It’s my job as the people’s lawyer to help Minnesotans afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect, especially when they have nowhere else to turn for help.
In the tradition of strong Minnesota attorneys general, that’s what I’ve done for Minnesotans, and what I’ll keep doing — because the fight for a fair economy is still on.
**When I first ran for Minnesota Attorney General three years ago, I promised to take on the high cost of drug prices. I have because no one should have to choose between affording their lives and affording to live. **We fought for and passed the Alec Smith Emergency Insulin Act and successfully defended it in court when Big Pharma sued to overturn it. I’m holding criminal opioid manufacturers accountable for the death and destruction they caused in our communities – seeking hundreds of millions of dollars in damages for treatment, remediation, and prevention in Minnesota.
**I promised I’d fight wage theft. I have because you should take home every dollar you’ve earned. **We fought for a new state law that gives the Minnesota Attorney General the power to enforce wage theft violations, and I set up a unit in my office dedicated to it. So far, we’ve already put more than a quarter-million dollars back into workers’ pockets.
**I promised to prioritize women’s economic security. I have because women and people of all genders must have the same opportunities and legal protections as men.** We started a first-of-its-kind task force on women’s economic security to identify the economic barriers women face so we can propose solutions. I’ve defended choice and reproductive freedom, including fighting the unconstitutional abortion-bans in Texas and Mississippi – all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court.
**I promised to focus on helping farmers and people in Greater Minnesota fight corporate power. I have because your zip code and community shouldn’t be a barrier to affording your life, and folks in Greater Minnesota face particular challenges.** I held telecom companies accountable for deceptive advertising and substandard service in Greater Minnesota. I called for a federal investigation of antitrust practices in the meatpacking industry and more federal protections for rural workers.
I’m proud of the progress we made, but right now, it’s fragile. There are powerful special interests aligned with my GOP opponents who want to make us less safe during the pandemic, restrict our right to vote, end our right to choose, make corporations more powerful, and the middle-class weaker.
We had the closest statewide race in Minnesota in 2018, and facing the uphill battle of a midterm election where our party holds the White House, we’re in for an even tougher fight this year. It will be the biggest test our movement has ever faced, and just like every challenge we’ve overcome, the only thing that’s going to get us over the edge is people-power.

clean_body: Hi, It’s my job as the people’s lawyer to help Minnesotans afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect, especially when they have nowhere else to turn for help. In the tradition of strong Minnesota attorneys general, that’s what I’ve done for Minnesotans, and what I’ll keep doing — because the fight for a fair economy is still on. | = Team, It’s my job as the people’s lawyer to help Minnesotans afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect, especially when they have nowhere else to turn for help. In the tradition of strong Minnesota attorneys general, that’s what I’ve done for Minnesotans, and what I’ll keep doing — because the fight for a fair economy is still on. When I first ran for Minnesota Attorney General three years ago, I promised to take on the high cost of drug prices. I have because no one should have to choose between affording their lives and affording to live. We fought for and passed the Alec Smith Emergency Insulin Act and successfully defended it in court when Big Pharma sued to overturn it. I’m holding criminal opioid manufacturers accountable for the death and destruction they caused in our communities – seeking hundreds of millions of dollars in damages for treatment, remediation, and prevention in Minnesota. I promised I’d fight wage theft. I have because you should take home every dollar you’ve earned. We fought for a new state law that gives the Minnesota Attorney General the power to enforce wage theft violations, and I set up a unit in my office dedicated to it. So far, we’ve already put more than a quarter-million dollars back into workers’ pockets. I promised to prioritize women’s economic security. I have because women and people of all genders must have the same opportunities and legal protections as men. We started a first-of-its-kind task force on women’s economic security to identify the economic barriers women face so we can propose solutions. I’ve defended choice and reproductive freedom, including fighting the unconstitutional abortion-bans in Texas and Mississippi – all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court. I promised to focus on helping farmers and people in Greater Minnesota fight corporate power. I have because your zip code and community shouldn’t be a barrier to affording your life, and folks in Greater Minnesota face particular challenges. I held telecom companies accountable for deceptive advertising and substandard service in Greater Minnesota. I called for a federal investigation of antitrust practices in the meatpacking industry and more federal protections for rural workers. I’m proud of the progress we made, but right now, it’s fragile. There are powerful special interests aligned with my GOP opponents who want to make us less safe during the pandemic, restrict our right to vote, end our right to choose, make corporations more powerful, and the middle-class weaker. We had the closest statewide race in Minnesota in 2018, and facing the uphill battle of a midterm election where our party holds the White House, we’re in for an even tougher fight this year. subject: twenty nine
body:
Hi, it's John Fetterman.
You wanna talk about why our elections are so messed up? Let’s start with the number 29... because it tells you everything you need to know.
👉 The average donation to our campaign is $29.
In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA, we’ve received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: ‘Why the hell would John need 582,000 $29 donations?’ Allow me to explain:
👉 A big super PAC called “Senate Leadership Fund” (name sounds really nice, huh?) has booked $29 MILLION+ in TV & radio ads to attack me + boost Dr. Oz.
This advertising onslaught against us starts in THREE DAYS. And as much as I hate to admit it, we know from experience that when super PACs beat people over the head with these stupid 30-second ads... they can drag you down in the polls.
So I’m emailing you today for something entirely predictable... $29. Because we’re behind on our mid-month goal. And, without a whole bunch of you, we aren’t going to be able to push back against this huge negative ad campaign.
So? Can I get $29 (or more or less, it really doesn’t matter) right now so we can meet our $275k mid-month deadline goal? Seriously, every dollar helps when you’re up against this kind of super PAC spending. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman]
DONATE $29 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=29]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman]
It shouldn’t be this way.
You shouldn’t have to be a gazillionaire like Dr. Oz to run for office.
You shouldn’t have super PACs spending $29 MILLION to sink good candidates with ridiculous (and may I add, false) 30-second ads.
But, until we get to the Senate and fight for real campaign finance reform, this is the world we live in. And the only way I know how to beat the Big Money is by energizing as many of YOU as possible to chip in $29 at a time.
We’ve got 88 days left, and the attacks are going to get worse and worse from here on out. If you can, please help us reach that $275k mid-month goal so we don’t fall behind + so we can compete toe to toe with the giant super PACs. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20220813_CGVA_Fetterman&amount=29]
Me + Gisele + our whole team are so grateful to each and every one of you. It’s because of all our grassroots donors and volunteers and supporters that we have a fighting chance to go up against all that big money and WIN.
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. subject: that was never who I was

body:
I could not be more grateful to be forging a new path for myself and my state and to become the leader Missouri deserves and needs.
| | |
---
Peter, I grew up in a family committed to its business. My dad built the largest brewing company in the world with the help of thousands of Missourians with good-paying union jobs. **And** **I could have dedicated my entire life to my family's company and sat out the rest. I could have lived on the sidelines and watched my community from the outside looking in.**
**But that was never who I was – and that sure wasn't the person my parents raised me to be.**
I've always wanted to give back to the people, the state, and the country that gave my family so much – and to give my whole heart to my community. **So as a young woman, I answered my call to service, became a nurse, and never looked back.** I found purpose and joy in giving back through volunteer work, advocacy, and charity. I made my own way in life and raised my own family.
And in recent years, as I watched so-called leaders fail my community time and time again, I once again realized that it was time to get off the sidelines. **From the opioid epidemic to abortion access and reproductive rights, so many of the biggest problems facing my community can only be solved with bold action from Washington.** And today, our leaders are choosing extremism, greed, and partisanship over the people they're supposed to serve.
I never in a million years thought that I would run for political office.**But I could not be more grateful to be forging a new path for myself and my state and to become the leader Missouri deserves and needs.**
**When I get to the Senate, I will work 24/7 to build bridges, put people first, find real solutions to serious problems, and bring compassion and honesty back to Washington.** Just as I always have, I will continue to form my own beliefs, my own values, and my own way by listening to the communities I serve and love.
**[But no one gets to Washington alone. To win in November and move our country forward, I need you on my team. body:
An extremist minority is imposing their unpopular views on the rest of America. But there are ways we can fight back — and we must. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49174184/361122893/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ7F_EGR_E_20220813_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZWViMTdkNC0xMzFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=19KnBhzNcr8Ud48HwT9vN3x0L3K-m4MdMFanegaU270=&emci=bbeb17d4-131b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=beeb17d4-131b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
I want to be direct. An extremist minority is imposing their unpopular views on the rest of America. But there are ways we can fight back — and we must. I have a plan on how we can restore our democracy so that a small group of right-wing radicals can no longer drown out the will of the people.
* Expand the Supreme Court to rebalance it.
* End the filibuster.

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: We WILL uphold the rule of law
body:
**[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993023:Jw4zG1VQN:m:1:3317145305:E5D0E2A27ED28F49BB490F7D7C228C12:r)**

Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993023:Jw4zG1VQN:m:1:3317145305:E5D0E2A27ED28F49BB490F7D7C228C12:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

body:
Westchester County registered voters are eligible to cast an early voting ballot.

Registered voters will be able to cast their ballot at any of the 23 designated early voting locations listed below.

Westchester County’s Election Inspectors will now use Electronic Poll Books and Ballot-on-Demand systems to facilitate Early Voting. There will be nine days of early voting before each election.

Only voters registered in the Democratic Party in the 16th and 17th Congressional Districts, and 34th Senatorial District are eligible to vote.

Only voters registered in the Republican and Conservative parties in the 17th Congressional District are eligible to vote.

Aug. 23, 2022 Primary Election New Early Voting Hours

Saturday, Aug. 13, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.

Sunday, Aug. 14, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.

Monday, Aug. 15, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.

Tuesday, Aug. 16, 2022 from noon until 8 p.m.

Wednesday, Aug. 17, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.

Thursday, Aug. 18, 2022 from noon until 8 p.m.

Friday, Aug. 19, 2022 from 8 a.m. until 4 p.m.

Saturday, Aug. 20, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.

Sunday, Aug. 21, 2022 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m.

Westchester County Early Voting Centers

Frequently Asked Questions for 2022 August Primary Election

For the 2022 August Primary Election, you can vote in person before Election Day.

What is Early Voting?

Westchester County registered voters can vote in-person before Election Day at any of the 23 early voting centers.

Who can vote early?

All Westchester County registered voters can vote early.

When can I vote early?

Early Voting period will be from Saturday, Aug.13, 2022 through Sunday, Aug. 21, 2022. The complete schedule is listed above.

Where can I vote early?

You can vote at any of the designated Early Voting sites throughout the County. These Early Voting centers are listed above.

How will I vote during early voting?

Voting during early voting is the same as voting on Election Day. When you get to the early voting center, you will check in to vote, receive your ballot and vote as any other election.

There will be instructions available at the early voting centers to familiarize you with the ballot. There will also be a notice to voter and bill of rights. You may ask an election inspector to explain how to vote, or if you need any assistance.

If you vote during the early voting period, you are not eligible to vote on Election Day.

body:

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177070/361134020/1793776944?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)

| | Hi, Last week, y’all sent in questions about voting rights — and today, as Deputy Organizing Director here at Fair Fight, I’m going to try to answer a few of them. So, let’s get into it: First, there were a couple of questions about how to vote in this fall’s midterm elections. **>From voter registration to polling places, here are the resources you’ll need to vote this fall:**
* **To check your voter registration:** If you’re in Georgia, check your registration at **[PeachVote.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177071/361134021/-631167602?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)**. If not, head to **[vote.org](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177072/361134022/1193288156?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)** and find your state.
* **To vote early and ensure your vote is counted:** Find the early voting schedule for your state on this **[_vote.org_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177073/361134023/1193288156?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)** calendar.
* **To vote in-person:** Search by your address on **[vote.org](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177074/361134024/1193288156?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)** for your polling place and ballot details.
* **To help with the voting process and be a poll worker:** Sign up at **[PowerThePolls.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177075/361134025/863224726?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)**.

**Now onto questions about the fight for voting rights...** Joan asked for an explanation on Georgia’s policy of dropping voters from voting lists. Georgia has a “use-it-or-lose-it” practice in which the Secretary of State purges voters from the voter rolls simply for not voting in recent elections. Last year, Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger put nearly 102,000 Georgian voters on a list to be removed and gave them little time to take action to keep themselves on the rolls. Anytime these attempts to purge eligible voters happen, Fair Fight springs into action, but we strongly suggest that [_**every Georgia voter checks their voter registration**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49177076/361134026/-631167602?refcode=em_20220813_e_l_amaanswers_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTFjODdhNC0xODFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kblBgSB0dx4ZCW5OlRpEX2Z1qaKoe1TQlw4H4OfLhS0=&emci=88952454-8119-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=991c87a4-181b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277) to make sure it is active and up to date. body:
| | | |
---
| South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem isn't one to mince words.
So, it's not surprising that when she was asked by the Boston news media for her assessment of the race for Massachusetts Governor, her answer was straightforward and decisive:
"Geoff's going to win."
---
Her answer wasn't just because Geoff and his running mate, Leah Allen, both won the Republican Convention in May (although they did). And it wasn't just because Geoff is leading his primary opponent by a three-to-one margin (which he is). It's because, as the Governor said, "leadership has consequences," and Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen are the only candidates in the race who can provide the leadership Massachusetts needs in 2023.
---
---
That leadership was also on display on The Kuhner Report this week, as Geoff was the only candidate in the race for Governor who had the courage and determination to sit down with "Boston's Bulldozer," Jeff Kuhner. Geoff's opponent declined an invitation to debate, so Geoff took advantage of more than an hour of air time to take questions from callers about his campaign, his vision for Massachusetts, and how he intends to fight for the People of Massachusetts.
---

Peter, I wanted to reach out to let you know that **I briefly appeared in front of the January 6th committee on Tuesday.**
Once it was clear they were using the interview as a political weapon against me, _**I cut it short.**_
My lawyers asked to record the interview so they couldn’t release deceptively edited clips to influence the election here in PA, but the committee denied my request. What are they hiding?
Their refusal to allow my lawyers to record the interview, or do a public interview as I’ve offered, makes it clear **they are doing this _just_ to STOP us from achieving our mission: returning the power to the people of Pennsylvania.**
Josh Shapiro has already gone on the offensive... using my refusal to take the bait as a fundraising opportunity, and another chance to manipulate Pennsylvania voters.

subject: The Senate's Inflation Reduction Act is a “Massive Power Grab”

name: Harriet Hageman
subject: You're fired, Liz
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Peter,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)

[DONATE NOW](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60993054:JAPJd1V1N:m:1:3331421248:926A42B0C17F22FA764C569B1E924436:r)

name: Jennifer Wexton
subject: I just voted for transformational legislation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Wexton for Congress
body:
If the Republicans had just four more seats in the House, the Inflation Reduction Act would never have even come to the floor for a vote.

I voted yesterday to pass the Inflation Reduction Act through the House. **I'm so proud to support a historic piece of legislation that will make a real difference for families across the country, and I can't wait for President Biden to sign it into law shortly.**

The Inflation Reduction Act will address rising costs of living by helping folks pay for gas and prescription drugs. It will strengthen the Affordable Care Act to make health insurance even more accessible. It will raise critical revenue by making the wealthiest corporations finally pay their fair share of taxes. And it's the biggest investment ever in clean and alternative energy — the bill's environmental provisions will jumpstart a new era in combating climate change and maintaining a good quality of life.

My opponent (following the lead of his party) strongly opposed this legislation. And if the Republicans had just four more seats, the Inflation Reduction Act would never have even come to the floor for a vote. **If we want to continue making progress, we _cannot_ allow the GOP to flip the House in November.**

[**Will you chip in to my re-election campaign? I'm going to keep fighting for families, but I'm facing a tough election in a seat that Republicans like Glenn Youngkin nearly won last year.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49164091/361083486/-772585877?refcode=EM_FR_220813MM_MM_JW_FULL_6_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWM2YmY0OC0wMjFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SzHeaZ6I58f8B5YAfE-VKdKsD5362l2xuOCmJdNshII=)

name: =?utf-8?Q?Douglas=20Carswell?=
subject: The corruption of American capitalism – update from your favorite think tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132556?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,

**Fifty one years ago this week, Richard Nixon made the most consequential decision of his presidency** – and it had nothing to do with Watergate.

**On August 15 th 1971, Nixon announced that the US dollar could no longer be converted into gold.** Up until that moment, the dollar was pegged to gold at $35 per ounce under what was called the Bretton Woods System. This international agreement committed the American government to backing every dollar overseas with gold.

“Big deal”, you might say. “What has some distant decision got to do with today?” Quite a lot, actually. It explains why government is big, inflation high, capitalism corrupted and why young Americans are voting left.

**For as long as dollars could be converted into gold, there was a limit on the number of dollars that the US government could put into circulation. ** Why? Because someone might come along with dollars and ask to exchange it for gold. Once dollars could no longer be converted into gold, the US government was free to create as many dollars as it liked.

This is pretty much what has happened ever since.

**Following Nixon’s announcement, the only thing restricting the amount of dollars that the government creates is the government. **And governments, sadly, are not very good at saying "no" to themselves.

This has produced persistent inflation. The graph below shows how inflation since 1971 dwarfs even the worst price increases during the whole of the nineteenth century and two world wars.
---
|
---
| The next graph shows how the amount of money (M3) in circulation has grown since 1971, with the most astronomical increases since 2019.
---
|
---
| The United States was founded by rebels demanding “no taxation without representation”.

**Thanks to Nixon’s decision, in order to raise revenue today the US government does not need permission from our representatives in Congress to raise tax. They can simply borrow instead. **

Take a look at the series of budget deficits that the US government has run up since 1971. Now that the dollar is merely a paper promise, issued by the Fed, the federal government is able to borrow almost at will. I imagine George III would have looked at such a scheme with envy. No need to worry about taxing tea when you can borrow and spend billions at will.
---
|
---
| Once the government is free to manipulate the currency to spend what it wants, it is also able to use monetary policy as a tool to steer the economy.

**At first the government only manipulated monetary policy to direct the economy in extreme circumstances, such as when the stock market crashed in October 1987.** The US Fed used monetary policy to ride to the rescue. They slashed interest rates to boost spending, cut savings and make shareholding more attractive to investors than holding cash.

A decade later, in the wake of the Asian financial crisis, the Fed did something similar. And then again with the collapse of LTMC, the world’s largest hedge fund. By the time the Fed used monetary stimulus in response to the dot com bubble bursting, or the collapse of Lehmans, it was almost expected.

**When Covid came, monetary stimulus in the form of low rates and QE was not a temporary measure. It had become a constant – but one that has begun to corrupt capitalism.**

Years of low interest rates and artificially easy money has caused all sorts of problems.

**Easy money means that asset prices have been inflated. The explosion of asset values benefits those with assets (often older) over those without (the young). (Ever wondered why so many young Americans vote left and say they are skeptical about free market capitalism?)**

Real wages have stagnated. (Ever wondered why blue collar America often seems so angry?)

You might not be able to see it right now, but an awful lot of bad investments have been made, with many ‘zombie’ companies – firms that are able to service their debts but not pay off the principle.

The ‘Nixon shock’ caught America by surprise in August 1971, but was soon overshadowed by Watergate. **Half a century on, it seems that sanctioning a burglary was not the worst decision Nixon made in the Oval Office.**

Where does all this leave conservatives today?

**If we are serious about reducing the size and reach of government, we cannot remain part of the Greenspan-to-****Powell consensus. A future conservative President and Congress are going to have to, at the very least, redefine the Fed’s terms of reference. **

Nothing lasts forever, and certainly not paper promises.

(Ever wondered why so many young Americans vote left and say they are skeptical about free market capitalism?) Real wages have stagnated. (Ever wondered why blue collar America often seems so angry?) You might not be able to see it right now, but an awful lot of bad investments have been made, with many ‘zombie’ companies – firms that are able to service their debts but not pay off the principle. The ‘Nixon shock’ caught America by surprise in August 1971, but was soon overshadowed by Watergate. Half a century on, it seems that sanctioning a burglary was not the worst decision Nixon made in the Oval Office. Where does all this leave conservatives today? If we are serious about reducing the size and reach of government, we cannot remain part of the Greenspan-to-Powell consensus. A future conservative President and Congress are going to have to, at the very least, redefine the Fed’s terms of reference. Nothing lasts forever, and certainly not paper promises. | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Have a great weekend! | | | Dear Fellow American, As a leader in the pro-life movement, I’m urgently reaching out to folks like you who believe in life, liberty, and the rule of law to join me in a special mission. [**Will you help me hold accountable members of the radical anarchist pro-abortion group “Reproductive Justice Union” for their attacks on my family and other pro-life advocates?** ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c4986a31cdc48d6acfccefc70c0317d&_e=AEVC0IWcBNyNo96TdtvWLcPNxUyPVzaJbSyimoExzd0aoNY6sp6ElABGePwLlA1E3RTXAVIgo_h-lcDw6jHvxo3fSCHRZX28NLaP711VOMBP2u6moZ82SP7hZPrpfl5z6auzbEVnjpb54eVXuqtOY3QMs-gzutSvLUJP8aadU4Abv0xJVGK5C2BU1v4vHy1FKyQwD28BGcN41VTsHcMIbh1v-_ylGqL387XjjYQQ_m9u3hU2FKl38HxY_zQ0fxRQLfpCC7a3b_06yNxPe22DL1ceJ_TzoDRs0GspZbQun8tPssXZAXwYFZbwICFgCK_tf09kXizHVrYaJuHu5IcNtXron-9xX6mPxPb9rFZT6scJZL8C6CVfQsMU2XhnT7ebeFkqy6Djx3WkqMhLT3rL-LLsXPH6suB2lKPuoUmcSuA%3D) Please, allow me to explain... My name is Tom Brejcha and I’m the president and founder of the Thomas More Society, a non-profit law firm dedicated to defending life, family, religious liberty, and election integrity. Perhaps you recognize my name from our work representing David Daleiden in his high-profile court battles with Planned Parenthood, the National Abortion Federation, and the state of California. In the days following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ “Reproductive Justice Union” made credible threats against me on Twitter. They “doxed” me, distributing flyers revealing my home address with my face front and center, highlighting all the things I’ve done to defend the right to life for preborn babies and our other shared values throughout my career.

---
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c4986a31cdc48d6acfccefc70c0317d&_e=AEVC0IWcBNyNo96TdtvWLcPNxUyPVzaJbSyimoExzd0aoNY6sp6ElABGePwLlA1E3RTXAVIgo_h-lcDw6jHvxo3fSCHRZX28NLaP711VOMBP2u6moZ82SP7hZPrpfl5z6auzbEVnjpb54eVXuqtOY3QMs-gzutSvLUJP8aadU4Abv0xJVGK5C2BU1v4vHy1FKyQwD28BGcN41VTsHcMIblYBlEqwgsetORAhA-KnkKNmq-WOM7zdI4yOYPsNB28hZ3MGnOa5sLrvQy6Wqxfy7zRP4pR9xUDfaKQ3Bjpyrt5eB1ct7VXxH45WcQkARse2h0aSkltrI-3MW1WfblShmTWMGM2ZYvrkJG--x_rV8w1sA3p1MzGh0H3sbIFazYRWhSGMxPmQP32cqAf6LaxoLIfabmLLsvt3yCmcB5UD9qk%3D)
---
And finally, on July 1st, they attacked our home. As police looked on, 40-50 thugs from “Reproductive Justice Union” gathered in front of my home screaming obscenities about me, the pro-life movement, and the Supreme Court. _**They tore up an American flag, shouting “Death to America,” and uprooted my wife’s beloved rose bush.**_ Then suddenly they launched loud smoke bombs, surged onto the lawn, and hurled paint bombs at our home. Fortunately, my wife and I were not home. We are safe and sound. But our property is not. The beautiful brick house — the home where my wife Debbie and I raised our two sons — is stained with indelible green paint. Worse, the “F” word, anarchist symbols (circled capital “A”), and ugly slogans like “No God, No Rulers” and “Abort the Supreme Court” cover our driveway and sidewalk. We've hired a series of experts to remove and/or paint over this graffiti, but some of it still won't come off. [**That’s why I’m asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to help the Thomas More Society hold these****criminals accountable — all while we******](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c4986a31cdc48d6acfccefc70c0317d&_e=AEVC0IWcBNyNo96TdtvWLcPNxUyPVzaJbSyimoExzd0aoNY6sp6ElABGePwLlA1E3RTXAVIgo_h-lcDw6jHvxo3fSCHRZX28NLaP711VOMBP2u6moZ82SP7hZPrpfl5z6auzbEVnjpb54eVXuqtOY3QMs-gzutSvLUJP8aadU4Abv0xJVGK5C2BU1v4vHy1FKyQwD28BGcN41VTsHcMIbocY2lE109ZigMXdlWxeV6J33yql0nkQN-Z8z-cweRQI8hqfyhtkxHh5knxVNKe3vGTV-48NP2ywPBVVHBHBio9doSW71ocdWK7WH0lq8JLBtFOu_337xnACDfxJkUwCWjEty0-liC_KhBK0f0mfaBNKXnxrXk-jy9DimzgFs019mYWvtzgeGERL-LV5JVdmqqcJ0PTXauCOd79lDu0IeQU%3D)[**continue defending life in court battles across the country**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c4986a31cdc48d6acfccefc70c0317d&_e=AEVC0IWcBNyNo96TdtvWLcPNxUyPVzaJbSyimoExzd0aoNY6sp6ElABGePwLlA1E3RTXAVIgo_h-lcDw6jHvxo3fSCHRZX28NLaP711VOMBP2u6moZ82SP7hZPrpfl5z6auzbEVnjpb54eVXuqtOY3QMs-gzutSvLUJP8aadU4Abv0xJVGK5C2BU1v4vHy1FKyQwD28BGcN41VTsHcMIbq1N6T_uPls15BFZQ3tZst_UYdCrTDfEnAebu_oqPHqBWqSt3fcGqg1QZzaHNnlZCP3qRzws2E9qsJ6a4mPPwKiputKdTJvV7dxRGzbGyyOYNxCoaSSkvOF90ph1XUNXe1KatF_qBfNtgjuZCE3b4t0Xf3vduR9N0jcCJN8TFqgpQCutn7XBNMdRBrKWJ5deOlYaSBFEHoZqM5oecLUns4I%3D)**.** You see, thanks to the Twitter threats against us earlier that week, we had just beefed up our home security system with new cameras. We also hired detectives who photographed the pro-abortionists' cars and license numbers. So, we may be able to identify and track down several suspects, one or more of whom drove up to our north suburban Chicago home from Missouri. Yet not one person has been held accountable. That’s right. As of now, no criminal charges have been filed. Sadly, I’m not the only target of radical pro-abortion activists in the aftermath of the _Dobbs_ decision. Pregnancy centers and churches alike have suffered vandalism and even arson at the hands of groups like “Reproductive Justice Union,” “Jane’s Revenge,” and other anarchist groups. **But these thugs cannot intimidate the Thomas More Society.** If the district attorneys don’t bring charges against the criminals responsible for the damage at my home and others, then we are prepared to file civil lawsuits! My friend, we must put a stop to these attacks, identify all of the perpetrators, and hold them accountable — so please do not delay. [**Please follow this link to donate $35, $50, $100 or more today.** ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7c4986a31cdc48d6acfccefc70c0317d&_e=AEVC0IWcBNyNo96TdtvWLcPNxUyPVzaJbSyimoExzd0aoNY6sp6ElABGePwLlA1E3RTXAVIgo_h-lcDw6jHvxo3fSCHRZX28NLaP711VOMBP2u6moZ82SP7hZPrpfl5z6auzbEVnjpb54eVXuqtOY3QMs-gzutSvLUJP8aadU4Abv0xJVGK5C2BU1v4vHy1FKyQwD28BGcN41VTsHcMIbu5lZNdDf4nCqgjXjvT3fhZ1pHZRVNIMEf5ujYPV5WfsUfnJEKis1XLf_-pAtK5jGo3YxC3uoBw68vGEdzqO65R4RLmFyM5QBybE900XmN6ueiMdlpcMvnOkeyQl8XmWXZB1a3rf33dgsf2V6h0Lz6xTYYpp77l0D1swzhQNeLjOyRC5jVjSy0M2W5DDpbSs-Bw6urOf9o2FO0j20YeV33c%3D) Mark my words: This is not the end of the violence we’ll see from the radical abortion lobby. In fact, I expect it will only escalate. subject: Volunteers Needed!
body:
Dr. Rodgers is taking to the ground, we need all hands-on deck. | | | |
---
| Dear Supporters,

As many of you know, my primary election was won by sheer determination. I called every phone and knocked on every door that I possibly could in the district with a handful of close friends and family.

This hard work carried me over the edge to secure the nomination as the Republican in the struggle for District 30. This is the first time in decades that a Republican may have a chance to flip this seat and I am not going down without a fight.
AND WE NEED YOUR HELP
While I was able to knock enough with a small team for my primary, we can't win in November on our own. We need all-hands-on-deck from next weekend to every day until _**November 8th**_ to bolster our grassroots army! We need help primarily on our door-to-door canvassing effort but will also take volunteers for phone banking and helping distribute lawn signs closer to election day.

As we are ramping our grassroots up, initial scheduling and area assignment will be given out on Wednesday, determinate on volunteer input! If you sign up below or reach out to Teams@jamesrodgersforcongress.com, I will make sure a team member is in constant contact with you.
---
| [CLICK TO VOLUNTEER HERE](https://jamesrodgersforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=832d15fe4bac469b8dcf34ddf&id=7cc77a6d71&e=0130f1c7b7 "CLICK TO VOLUNTEER HERE")
---
|
---
|
---
| I will ask one more favor, please share this email with****_**five of your friends.**_ It is important that we build a coalition to take on this fight together and I can only do it with your help. Even if someone can only volunteer one day, that will make the difference.
_Every voter that is spoke with can bring change._
Once again, thank you so much for your continued support. Just as David slew Goliath, we can persevere, but it starts with faith!

I look forward to seeing you all next Saturday on August 20th!

God Bless,

---

body:
If you live in the Santa Rosa area, join us for a Meet & Greet Fundraiser event for Peggy Schiller this Tuesday, August 16th. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b12f985f795/join-us-tuesday-peggy-schiller-meet-greet-fundraiser?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| | Hello Peter,

**You are invited!**

If you are local to the Panhandle area and would like the opportunity to meet the presumptive Democratic nominee for Congress, **Peggy Schiller,** please join us on Tuesday.

At this event hosted by Wade Gilliam and myself, you will** learn more about Peggy's qualifications, platform, and vision for the district. **

---
|
---
|
We will be at the **Black Bear Bread Bar Room** located at 26 Logan Lane, Unit H, in Santa Rosa Beach this **Tuesday, August 16th at 6:00PM.**

You will have the chance to ask Peggy questions, mingle with like-minded people, and enjoy light hors d'oeuvres.**I know Peggy would love to meet those of you who live in the area. **

**The suggested donation to attend is $100.** If you are unable to make this event, please consider making a much appreciated donation to the campaign.

---
| [Donate Today >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=7fe5edb092&e=9c22e4067b "Donate Today >")
---
| **It's time to send a strong message to Matt Gaetz that we intend to vote him out this November.** The First Congressional District deserves a representative who will put the needs of the district first.

I hope you'll come out to meet Peggy this week!

Thanks,
Karen
---

All throughout American history, civil rights groups have fought to gain access to the most fundamental American right -- the right to vote. They fought against the full-blown denial of voting rights to women and people of color, literacy tests, and poll taxes.
In the modern day, we are faced with different, but no less dangerous, threats to voting. We’re fighting against gerrymandering, voter suppression, election denialism, and disenfranchisement of minority communities.
[**The fight for voting rights is ever-changing, but persists nonetheless.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49193850/361170351/1354114381?utm_campaign=20220813_aotl_o_ptp2event_actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE2ZmM1NmM5LTMxMWItZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sIcFjH2BFnhhyGlXYr20a5I8SkDcabXexPiIRVbduTg=&emci=9d718c29-4c1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a6fc56c9-311b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=8431045)
We have a duty to carry on the legacy of those who risked their lives protecting voting rights. Our focus is now on the 2022 midterm elections and our new partnership with Power the Polls.
To combat recent voter suppression tactics, we need poll workers who wholeheartedly support American democracy.
Can you help carry on the legacy of those who fought for voting rights in the past by serving as a poll worker and preserving democracy?
[**Join us on Tuesday August 16 at 8 EST for an event with AOTL and Power the Polls. We’ll celebrate Poll Worker Recruitment Day and speak on the necessity of poll workers to uphold democracy.** ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49193851/361170358/1354114381?utm_campaign=20220813_aotl_o_ptp2event_actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE2ZmM1NmM5LTMxMWItZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sIcFjH2BFnhhyGlXYr20a5I8SkDcabXexPiIRVbduTg=&emci=9d718c29-4c1a-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a6fc56c9-311b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=8431045)
