Friend, Marco Rubio is attacking my 27 years of law enforcement service, so I'm reaching out to set the record straight.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is that some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need the resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

**[If you can spare $5, will you donate before midnight to help me counter Rubio's attacks?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49171968/361115449/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4028-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODI3MzkzZS0xMDFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U0N42ouSGMnYJSHNJWdpQfiqaonWidY8p4y6nbzzkXY=)**

I was one of a few women in a class of 30 when I joined the police academy – and I always remembered what my mom had told me: "Be the best you can be, even if people say you don't belong."
And when it came time to choose a class president, one of the other women in our class convinced me to run. I was nervous, but I went for it – and I won by a landslide.
**I graduated not only as class president but at the top of my class.** When I got out of the academy, I went straight to work protecting and serving my community. And after decades of service, **I became the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.**
Fast forward to today: I'm about to take on my biggest challenge yet. There are obstacles ahead, but with my "never tire" attitude and a massive grassroots movement behind me, I know that I can become Florida's next U.S. senator and expand our Democratic Senate majority.

**[If you're on my side, please donate $5 or whatever you can right now to help me share my story with more voters and defeat Marco Rubio.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49171970/361115451/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4028-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODI3MzkzZS0xMDFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U0N42ouSGMnYJSHNJWdpQfiqaonWidY8p4y6nbzzkXY=)**

**I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. If naysayers like Rubio think their attacks will make me feel defeated, they've got another thing coming. I've heard it all before – and I've only come out stronger.**
Thank you for joining this grassroots movement.

Chief Val Demings

I never thought I’d run for public office.
#

Friends —
I’ll be honest with you: When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out.
I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family — and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
I never thought more than 1 million people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.
And I never thought that I’d need to ask supporters to do more than that to defend this seat.

To boot, she thinks the Jan. 6 insurrection was "legitimate political discourse." In short, Friend, she'd be a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell and his backward agenda. We _cannot_ afford to send someone like her to the Senate. **So please, with the primary behind us, this is too important to wait:[Before our crucial midnight fundraising deadline, will you chip in $5 or more to become a Founding Donor to our general election campaign, defend this Democratic seat, and protect our razor-thin Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1232-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)** Thanks for pitching in at this pivotal moment, Dick \---------- Forwarded message ----------

With less than 100 days to go before Election Day, the stakes of our Senate race here in Connecticut just got even higher, Friend.
The primary results are in, and I'm officially facing off against Trump's hand-picked candidate in the general election - a radical Republican who will be nothing but a rubber stamp on Mitch McConnell's disastrous agenda. She opposes a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions. She opposes common sense gun safety measures. And she supports calling January 6th _" legitimate political discourse."_
**If my opponent flips this seat red in November, Republicans _will_ regain the Senate majority. It's as simple as that. And there's no question that her first official act as Connecticut's senator will be reinstalling Mitch McConnell as majority leader.**
A Republican majority with McConnell at the helm would be an absolute _nightmare_ for our country. We already know the kinds of dangerous policies that would follow: A national abortion ban. Relentless attacks on voting rights, women, contraception, and the LGBTQ community. Obstruction of any attempts to make progress protecting our planet - even as we live through a summer of unprecedented floods, drought, and unusual forest fires.
Simply put, the GOP would block any of President Biden's attempts to make progress for the American people. McConnell has promised he will block all nominations. There goes legislation. Judges. Everything. Period.
**That 's why, as we head into the most pivotal weeks of this campaign, I'm personally asking for your help. We need to raise $15,000 by midnight to ensure I have the resources to take on my radical GOP opponent in the general election and defend this critical seat. **
**We don 't have time on our side, Friend, so I'm counting on you to step up right away: [Please, before our midnight fundraising deadline, will you donate $5 or more to keep this seat blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? Dick

[During his closing statement to the January 6th committee, Rep. Adam Schiff made it clear just how fragile our democracy can be.

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary.

That’s why when you watch the trailer for our newest free online teaching series, “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ,” you’ll notice that your professor, Dr. Laffer, is accompanied by Larry Kudlow, Steve Forbes, Amity Shlaes, and others. Together they explain the fascinating history of economics in America and what is required to restore economic freedom and prosperity to our great nation.

I’d like you to be one of the first people to preview this new series. **You can watch your video and pre-register for the new series below:**

In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer—famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan—provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics—taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade—and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy.

In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as:

* **Steve Forbes** , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media.
* **Stephen Moore** , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy.
* **Brian Domitrovic** , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity.
* **Larry Kudlow** , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump.
* **Amity Shlaes** , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression.
* And, **Larry P. Arnn** , President of Hillsdale College.

This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity—timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.”

body:
From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I couldn’t be more grateful to our volunteers, staff, supporters, and families for helping us beat the odds at so many points along this journey. | | |
---
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49195768/361178751/1375102342?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDgwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDExNzA5ZC0zYTFiLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4m3fPZLeuZfvXP-prA2iziMh9SghMS9iJ8RpGKt60o=&emci=f2243dae-371b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=6411709d-3a1b-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=26536248)

Dear Peter, From the bottom of my heart, **thank you**. I couldn’t be more grateful to our volunteers, staff, supporters, and families for helping us beat the odds at so many points along this journey.

The race started last year with 13 candidates. In June, we were 1 of 8 campaigns to qualify for the ballot, making history as the first South Asian candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. In July, we were 1 of 5 campaigns to get into the televised debate, after which analysts declared us the winner. This week, we earned our spot in the final 2 major candidacies on Election Day. I’m proud that we lit a spark in people – a belief that a different way in politics is possible. Instead of running on consultant-fed talking points, we started our campaign with a Dignity Tour to hear from Wisconsinites closest to the issues. We talked about the root causes of inaction and political dysfunction. That’s why we premised our campaign on changing the system, helping people find our common humanity across lines of division, and electing public leaders with the integrity, compassion, and courage to do what's right, not what's politically expedient.
---
| |
---
When I voted on Election Day, I didn’t just see my name on the ballot. I saw the movement we have grown across Wisconsin and our nation. I saw the countless communities that welcomed us into their homes and hearts, from Howard to Neillsville, Benton to Madison, Readstown to New Berlin, Milwaukee to Kenosha. Thank you for your generosity and for believing in our mission. I also want to thank and congratulate my friend Mandela Barnes on becoming the Democratic nominee. We had the opportunity to speak on election night, and I look forward to working with him to reform our political system and incentivize Congress to work for all Wisconsinites.
---
| |
---
Our biggest competition was never the other primary contenders – it has always been a multi-billion dollar political industry that is highly invested in protecting the status quo. We beat this system by building the diverse, unlikely coalition of Democrats, Republicans, and Independents required to create real change and save our democracy. We beat the system by giving people something to vote FOR, not just against. We beat the system by activating new voices and voters to get involved in our political process. I'm proud that we have successfully united politically homeless and disaffected voters which we call the Exhausted Majority. Wisconsinites shared in the last few weeks that ours is the first campaign that they have been excited to vote for in over a decade, or in some cases, the first one ever. In the words of a young supporter, our campaign isn’t changed by politics. We change politics. Bobby Kennedy once described that when each of us stands up for an ideal, we set forth a ripple of hope that becomes an unstoppable current. That’s what we have accomplished in this campaign. And we’re just getting started. With gratitude,Steven

clean_body: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I couldn’t be more grateful to our volunteers, staff, supporters, and families for helping us beat the odds at so many points along this journey. | | | | | Dear Peter, From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I couldn’t be more grateful to our volunteers, staff, supporters, and families for helping us beat the odds at so many points along this journey. The race started last year with 13 candidates. In June, we were 1 of 8 campaigns to qualify for the ballot, making history as the first South Asian candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. In July, we were 1 of 5 campaigns to get into the televised debate, after which analysts declared us the winner. This week, we earned our spot in the final 2 major candidacies on Election Day. I’m proud that we lit a spark in people – a belief that a different way in politics is possible. Instead of running on consultant-fed talking points, we started our campaign with a Dignity Tour to hear from Wisconsinites closest to the issues. We talked about the root causes of inaction and political dysfunction. That’s why we premised our campaign on changing the system, helping people find our common humanity across lines of division, and electing public leaders with the integrity, compassion, and courage to do what's right, not what's politically expedient. | | When I voted on Election Day, I didn’t just see my name on the ballot. I saw the movement we have grown across Wisconsin and our nation. I saw the countless communities that welcomed us into their homes and hearts, from Howard to Neillsville, Benton to Madison, Readstown to New Berlin, Milwaukee to Kenosha. Thank you for your generosity and for believing in our mission. I also want to thank and congratulate my friend Mandela Barnes on becoming the Democratic nominee. We had the opportunity to speak on election night, and I look forward to working with him to reform our political system and incentivize Congress to work for all Wisconsinites. | | Our biggest competition was never the other primary contenders – it has always been a multi-billion dollar political industry that is highly invested in protecting the status quo. We beat this system by building the diverse, unlikely coalition of Democrats, Republicans, and Independents required to create real change and save our democracy. We beat the system by giving people something to vote FOR, not just against. We beat the system by activating new voices and voters to get involved in our political process. I'm proud that we have successfully united politically homeless and disaffected voters which we call the Exhausted Majority. Wisconsinites shared in the last few weeks that ours is the first campaign that they have been excited to vote for in over a decade, or in some cases, the first one ever. In the words of a young supporter, our campaign isn’t changed by politics. We change politics. Bobby Kennedy once described that when each of us stands up for an ideal, we set forth a ripple of hope that becomes an unstoppable current. That’s what we have accomplished in this campaign. And we’re just getting started. With gratitude,Steven | | | Paid for by Olikara for Senate. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- Olikara for Senate P.O. If you remember, in the last 10 years, we witnessed relatively steady gas prices - fluctuating by not more than a dollar or less from year to year.

But not this year.

This year we’ve seen prices climb as high as $7 in some counties!

I’ve had enough!

We have to stop making it hard on Californians to get to work, take their kids to school, or to get groceries.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=658%2E5257348%2EiQR_5C ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek — Is there anything we can say to convince you to
contribute to Adam's campaign today? Even just $5?

What if we told you that despite our slim margins in Congress, we just
passed the biggest investment in our climate and renewable energy in our
country's history — while also allowing Medicare to negotiate the cost of
prescription drugs?

What if we told you that if we're able to keep our House majority, and
expand our majority in the Senate by just another 1-2 seats, we could do
even more?

That we could abolish the filibuster, codify Roe, raise the minimum wage,
and ban assault weapons? And make more climate investments?

What if we told you that if Republicans take control, all of the progress
we’ve made could be reversed? That Republicans could succeed in ending
meaningful oversight, and pave the way from another dangerous and abusive
Trump administration. In fact, Kevin McCarthy is already threatening to
strip Adam of his committee assignments if Republicans take the House, and
Donald Trump is tearing into Adam at every opportunity he has in front of
a microphone to rile up his extreme MAGA base.

No one would have thought that we would get so much done in a 50-50 Senate
and no margin for error. But we did.

The work of government is slow, and isn't pretty. But together, we've
passed the Inflation Reduction Act, the $1.9 trillion American Rescue
Plan, the $1.2 trillion Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the first gun
safety bill in 30 years, and the CHIPS and Science Act, which will invest
hundreds of billions of dollars into the manufacturing of the future right
here in the United States and help bring inflation down.

But this is just the beginning, and we’re clear-eyed about the stakes and
the possibilities of the next two years. If we’re able to protect and
expand our Democratic majorities this November, more progressive policies
will come to fruition and push our nation forward.

So are you ready to contribute,
Derek?

Peter,

The election is officially less than three months away. With so much at stake this November, we wanted to share why Washingtonians can't afford to have Kim's Republican opponent, Matt Larkin, in Congress.

Larkin is a MAGA Republican. He's a staunch supporter of Donald Trump, even once saying, "I love all of the things the President is doing... It's nice to see a President not care." Larkin also has refused to say whether Joe Biden's victory in 2020 was legitimate.

body:
Dear Friend,
Yesterday, I made it official: I filed my papers as the Democratic Nominee for Congress from San Francisco. Of all the honors conferred to me by my colleagues – Whip, Leader, Speaker of the House – there is none greater than that conferred to me by my constituents in electing me as their Representative.
After this unprecedented and historic week, it is clear that Democrats are giving much more leverage to the people rather than the special interests. I wanted to share with you – our VIPS, our volunteers in politics who make everything we do in Washington possible – my Statement of Candidacy that outlines our work For The People this term and respectfully ask that you support my campaign.
Please follow me on Twitter [https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi] , join us for our Weekly Volunteer Grassroots Updates, and stay tuned for upcoming VIP volunteer opportunities to help re-elect our great Democratic Representatives and elect Democratic challengers running to unseat Republicans in districts across America.
My full statement is here: [https://youtu.be/OkKd2bNDnoI]
https://youtu.be/OkKd2bNDnoI [https://youtu.be/OkKd2bNDnoI]
Statement of Candidate as the Democratic Nominee for Congress From San Francisco
It is my honor to represent San Francisco and our values of liberty, justice and equality for all in Congress.
As your Representative, I have brought home billions in resources to support good paying union jobs, housing, green infrastructure, health care and public education.
During my current term, we delivered COVID relief to put money in people's pockets, vaccinations in arms, children back in school, and people safely back to work; Infrastructure funding to rebuild with fairness and protect the environment; CHIPS and Science legislation for American independence from the supply chain and inclusive innovation in STEM; the Inflation Reduction Act to reduce health care costs, create jobs and tackle the climate crisis; the PACT Act to protect our veterans exposed to burn pits; historic gun violence prevention to make communities safer; and diplomacy to strengthen our alliances abroad.
And we need more. That’s why we are expanding the Affordable Care Act; strengthening Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid; increasing resources for increasing resources for HIV/AIDS, mental wellness and persons with disabilities; and addressing Monkeypox.
Our progress is about meeting people’s needs and putting working people over entrenched special interests. While big business lobbies against lower prices for insulin, gas, and groceries, I’m protecting consumers and fighting price gouging. While extremists push a national abortion ban and undermine privacy rights, I’m fighting for reproductive freedom and marriage equality.
I am running for re-election to continue our fight to improve people’s lives and defend our Democracy, and respectfully seek your vote.
Thank you,
Nancy
Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

Peter –
The Inflation Reduction Act has passed the House and is moving on to be signed into law. This legislation doesn’t just aim to curb inflation – it will expand Medicare benefits, lower health care costs, make historic climate & energy investments, and close tax loopholes for wealthy corporations.
This progress for our country would not have been possible without our Senators Raphael Warnock & Jon Ossoff and our Democratic Congressmembers. They chose to serve the American people instead of the special interests & corporations that fought against this bill.
Our current Representative Buddy Carter claims that the Inflation Reduction Act won’t do anything for the American people. “Do nothing” sounds more like Buddy’s daily agenda than this groundbreaking piece of legislation.
In a moment, we’re going to ask for your financial support, and here’s why: this victory proves how crucial this November's election is here in Georgia.
Elections matter. Your vote matters.
These kinds of victories for the American people are the ones Wade will fight for every day in office.

subject: Woke activist prosecutors have abdicated their duties for far too long!
body:
**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60992947:JDPna1VN5:m:1:3331421248:73EAF51AB0D42E76646CD447A7B934A3:r)**

Peter,
You've seen across the country a wave of woke prosecutors funded by out of state interests refusing to uphold the rule of law who are allowing criminals to walk free without ever facing consequences for their crimes. As Governor, I have made it clear: **In this state, we uphold the rule of law. We respect the law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe.**

We DO NOT allow woke activist prosecutors to abdicate their duty to do their job and protect their communities. This is why I took action to right the wrongs of a prosecutor whose conduct has fallen below the standard that is required by the Florida Constitution by refusing to enforce laws he doesn't like. A prosecutor is not a law unto himself.

**_[[UPHOLD THE RULE OF LAW]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60992947:JDPna1VN5:m:1:3331421248:73EAF51AB0D42E76646CD447A7B934A3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327bc960403d9d6cbc7bf571d819c9300408453fabc7720711dfcdc8d6d712f8c75a5fe90ab67d379481cf2fa49bfdf629a")_**

We are not going to allow this pathogen of ignoring the law that's been going on around the country to get a foothold in the state of Florida. We are going to make sure that our laws are enforced and that no individual prosecutor puts themselves above the law.

It's simple. If you put yourself above the law, you are violating and neglecting your duty and you are displaying a lack of competence to be able to perform those duties. If you abandon the duties of your oath of office, you no longer have the right to hold that office.

The crime in places like San Francisco and Los Angeles is out of control. Police are unable to do their jobs, businesses are closing up shop, and violent criminals are walking free all because of the dereliction of duty by prosecutors who are funded by ideological activists. In Florida, we're not going to sit idly by and watch our state spiral into chaos. We're going to respect our law enforcement officers, we're going to protect our citizens, and we're going to enforce the law.

As your Governor, I will not stand for woke prosecutors, who are entrusted with enforcing the law, showing more deference and care for criminals than the victims of their crimes in the name of "social justice." Denying a victim their day in court is not justice. Allowing a criminal to walk free of consequences for their crimes is not justice. It is, in fact, the opposite of justice.

**_[[REJECT WOKE PROSECUTORS]](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60992947:JDPna1VN5:m:1:3331421248:73EAF51AB0D42E76646CD447A7B934A3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de93327e26993ba67113f8689f06e8ca94ebda36bd320efd24e432ee79049f01519eca11f1dc046e8b3a44077fbaced8a682f9a")_**

Florida is a law-and-order state. I am not going to back down from that one inch. The radical Left is already attacking me for doing my job to ensure that the laws are enforced in our state. They are going to use my suspension of a state attorney refusing to do his job to appeal to the members of the woke mob and add to their war chest.

Like I've said before, Peter, I will never allow political favor to sway my resolve to do what's right. I need to know that I can count on your support as I prepare to go head-on against the Democrats' crusade against law and order. **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60992947:JDPna1VN5:m:1:3331421248:73EAF51AB0D42E76646CD447A7B934A3:r "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=645171481de933275f93e2240482fd3499e8163be20c6fbccf3cfae8ca859ecc3f7e5669955f9d09276a697c2b71a24aa50c2e825ad8b5ba")_**

You can check it out **[here.](http://links.sarahkleehoodny.com/u/click?_t=4042bf8ec2414cd7ba40b5db51a7d947&_m=2a3e7a247dc940458bc66458fc7b0a5f&_e=EhkjObtKfppNChdmUmDsGReFdVlsGInC8PZ53uiQPAgZVETpRfKgWKfK2RqkopjahU2lAFuaz3yA1nRilSduaNdfC6jeiJmJjEL_Haey_XXVd__7l6bLp8C9UcrbZw0G0qtB0bq89zNuX1jTvoDcyscJnZCy2d65P50iOmZwHGHsUHN_dR3GkSo1s7H-FvRCo3WGa6UKMwjgg7Ld2i1JxO3_naoX2G4lq9VXPdmycPQSzyIGutzEGvpTW9ciKLKX4LCNMjvZNLw_EENCXutLe7yoOuXNEZhcOQsxtRBL13rhHMxYsUiutVqicGVu0bpt0pop79u8CNUOfIK31KNQFVcXbR7uHb9I6z-pHsuqwRrDvm2fUQ3UCrVAZ4D7UmS3dFU9svMjDAtg63xYZ2pTbHyJkaGzjWfFcI0wGr7e2Io%3D)** At the most recent Democratic candidate forum in Utica, the moderator asked me what the most immediate issue is for when I get to Congress. **I answered without hesitation, campaign finance reform.** When dark money groups and billionaire-funded super PACs are allowed to give enormous amounts of money to candidates to help them win races, it weakens the voice of the people, endangers our democracy, and opens the door to serious corruption. The only way to restore our faith in democracy and solve the systemic issues we face is to rebuild an even playing field.In this race in NY-22, crypto billionaires have spent $400,000 in support of my opponent, Francis Conole. That has a very real impact and tips the scale **against the people of New York.****[Billionaires think they can buy this seat in Congress. body:

| | | | | Peter, **Just when you think the Republican Party and American politics can't sink any lower, she's back.** **Sarah Palin.** The twice impeached Republican President--both times for betraying our national security--is being investigated under the Espionage Act for stealing classified documents and storing them among the bedbugs, sycophants and spies at Mar-a-Lago. So here comes Sarah Palin, who's run out of reality shows, cheap gimmicks and family values (her husband Todd divorced her a few years ago, accusing her of abuse), reentering a political system she helped debase in 2008 with her casual stupidity and endless conspiracies. [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T61950986-d4ab-41e9-99f6-9804c515dd4d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Palin's running for the vacant seat in Congress from Alaska. She was joined by Trump at a rally the very day Mar-a-Lago was raided, and put out the following crass, dishonest and riot-inciting statement (See FBI Building, Cincinnati) in response to the FBI raid to retrieve stolen state secrets----including some on nuclear technology--that Trump may have been selling to our enemies:** _**If Palin wins the seat from Alaska, she'll have the large soapbox afforded her by her fame from which to attack our democracy and institutions, weakening the rule of law. It would be like taking Marjorie Taylor Greene or Lauren Boebert and injecting them with steroids. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous.**_ **Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. Native Alaskan and Democrat Mary Peltola is running for the seat, and if Democrats list her first, and she's listed second on enough ballots by independents and Republicans angry at the other Republicans for attacking their top choice, she can win!**

body:
We’ll be blunt, team: we need your help today.
#

Team -
We’ll be blunt — our fundraising slowed down a bit this week, and we’re reaching out because we need your help to pick up the pace before our mid-month fundraising drive comes to a close on Monday.
Since we launched this campaign, tens of thousands of people have stepped up so far to pitch in whatever they can to help elect Cheri Beasley — even $5 or $20 at a time makes a difference. It’s put us in a strong position with a clear path to victory.
We wish what we raised already was enough. But the truth is that races as close and competitive as this one are extremely expensive. We know Republican super PACs plan to flood our state with at least $33 million worth of ads alone.
We’re so grateful to have you on our team, because winning this race will take a lot of grassroots support from people like you.
[**That’s why we’re asking if you can make your first online contribution today to help elect Cheri Beasley ahead of our August mid-month fundraising deadline.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220813-2-ma&refcode2=1439.357359.25diPF&t=2&akid=1439%2E357359%2E25diPF)
The outcome of North Carolina’s Senate race will be a key factor in determining whether we protect (and hopefully expand!) our Democratic Senate majority in just a few short months.
With the future of our planet, abortion rights, voting rights, and so much more on the ballot this year, it’s crucial that we win North Carolina. It’s time we elect a Senator who is unafraid to cast the decisive 51st vote for progress.
**That Senator will be Cheri Beasley. But she can’t win this alone.**

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Stopping Manchin’s Dirty Deal | Fast Food Worker Justice in CA
w/ Ro Khanna | McDonald’s Worker Tells Her Story | Ash Kalra on AB 257 |
MN Wins - Ilhan Omar, Keith Ellison | VT Wins - Balint, Zuckerman, Welch |
|& MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6179?t=1011&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]We’re shifting the window of what’s possible. Become a recurring
monthly donor to Our Revolution to maximize our collective impact in
Washington.
★ ★ ★

Join our LIVE National Organizing Call this Monday at 8:30 pm ET/5:30 PT,
with Jasmine Crockett, who’s headed to the US House from TX-30, to talk
about how we grow progressive power in Congress.

We’ll also dig into the importance of winning at the local level with
Megan Green on her run for chair of the Board of Aldermen in St. Louis, MO
and Robert Jackson on his race for re-election to the NY State Senate.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=1012&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]RSVP
★ ★ ★

MANCHIN’S DIRTY DEAL
TO FAST-TRACK FOSSIL FUELS
Our Revolution is organizing NOW to stop a secret deal Joe Manchin just
cut with Democratic leadership to fast-track fossil fuels — further
canceling out the climate gains remaining in Democrats’ Inflation
Reduction Act (IRA).

Pelosi and Schumer are set to give Manchin what he wants - more pipelines,
more drilling, fewer regulations for fossil fuels, and fewer safeguards
for impacted communities — all packaged in the upcoming *must-pass*
resolution to continue funding the government.

It’s insanity for our leaders to even consider this while hailing a
historic climate bill. Don’t hesitate to [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=1013&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]contact your House Rep now to
make these demands:

— Don’t fast-track new gas or oil projects
— Don’t fast-track carbon pipelines
— Don’t cut environmental safeguards in fossil fuel projects
— Separate the fast-track vote from the must-pass resolution to fund the
government

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6271?t=1014&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Stop Manchin — MAKE THE CALL

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6228?t=1015&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

MINNESOTA WINS

Congratulations to US Rep. Ilhan Omar who won a hard-fought race against
big money and a conservative Democratic challenger in Minnesota’s 5th
District.

Rep. Omar serves as the whip of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, and
she’s a potent ally in the fight for living wages, climate action,
immigrant rights, Medicare for All and so much more.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6179?t=1016&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Join our inside-outside work with elected allies like Ilhan, Rashida,
Bernie, and others as a sustaining member of Our Revolution.

Our Revolution board member and Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison
won his primary Tuesday and we’ll have his back all the way through
November!

A leading national voice for criminal justice, Keith successfully
prosecuted Derek Chauvin for the murder of George Floyd. He’s been a
steadfast ally in the fight for justice on all fronts - racial, economic,
environmental, health, and worker justice.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6179?t=1017&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Become a recurring donor to Our Revolution to fund our mission of
building progressive power at every level of government. The more of us
there are, the more we can achieve together.
[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6187?t=1018&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Join our inside-outside work with elected allies like Rashida, Erika
and Abraham in the fight for living wages, climate action, immigrant
rights, Medicare for All and so much more.

★ ★ ★
VERMONT WINS
Congratulations to all three of Our Revolution’s Vermont candidates - also
endorsed by Bernie - who won their primaries on Tuesday!

US Rep. Peter Welch will now likely head to the US Senate! Peter has
worked with Bernie for years in the state, representing Vermont in
Congress since 2007.

In Congress, he cosponsored the Green New Deal and he’s led on lowering
drug prices, childcare, rural broadband, and protecting our imperiled
democracy.

State Rep. Becca Balint won her race Tuesday and is on her way to being
Vermont’s Representative in the US House.

As VT Senate Majority Leader, Becca passed the first gun safety laws in
state history, invested in affordable housing, and passed the strongest
reproductive rights in the nation.

David Zuckerman, a long-serving progressive, independent voice in the VT
House and Senate, won the Democratic nomination for Lt. Governor!

David is an organic regenerative farmer and a small business owner, who in
elected office has led on universal healthcare, marriage equality,
cannabis reform, raising wages, renewable energy, water quality, and more.
★ ★ ★

THE MARGIN MATTERS IN MONTGOMERY CO!

The contest for Montgomery County Executive is coming down to the wire!
Progressive incumbent Marc Elrich declared victory this week over Big
Pharma CEO David Blair with a 42-vote advantage.

Such a close margin practically guaranteed a recount, but the efforts of
our call team and organizing in Maryland paid off in this race for a
lifelong champion of tenants' rights, affordable housing, and more.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6179?t=1019&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Become a recurring donor TODAY to keep getting progressive candidates
over the finish line in races across the country. Let’s build power
together.

★ ★ ★

This 2022 primary season, Our Revolution Phonebank Force has made more
than 500,000 calls to voters across the country. Right now, we have
shifts for incredible candidates for Congress like Brittany Ramos-DeBarros
(NY-11), David Segal (RI-2), Melanie D’Arrigo (NY-3), and many others!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1020&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]COMMIT TO A CALL SHIFT

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

WORKER BILL ADVANCES IN CA

GREAT NEWS! AB 257 - the FAST Recovery Act to give California fast food
workers a seat at the table - passed through the Appropriations Committee
Thursday and heads to the full Senate for a vote the next week.

Our Revolution activists and allies have worked for years for historic
legislation like this, as Fight for $15 lays out [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6278?t=1021&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]here, and we’re
muscling the bill to Gov. Newsom’s desk.

On Wednesday, we strategized with worker activist Angelica Hernandez, US
Rep. Ro Khanna, and CA Assemblymember Ash Kalra, on an [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6279?t=1022&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]Organizing Call
to rally collective action in this final push for the bill

Angelica, who’s worked at McDonald’s in Los Angeles for 18 years, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6279?t=1023&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]told
us of an industry rife with wage theft, sexual harassment, discrimination,
violence, and health and safety issues.

During the pandemic, things got worse, she said. “McDonald’s didn’t
protect us. They made billions while we did the job of 2-3 people for
minimum wage to survive, always fearful of getting infected and infecting
our families.”

“I’ve faced retaliation because I raise my voice, they cut my hours, but
it’s worth it to fight for my coworkers,” she said. “We need AB 257. We
want to live, work and retire with dignity.”

US Rep. Ro Khanna said passing AB 257 is his top priority in California
and could be a model for workers’ councils that can be replicated state by
state.

“This is one of the wealthiest places in the world. Fast food and other
service workers must be able to take part in that prosperity and have
dignity and security,” he said.

Ro put it bluntly on our call: “There’s no reason these jobs can’t support
families and communities. You can treat people with respect and still make
a profit.”

CA Assemblymember Ash Kalra, who co-authored AB 257, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6279?t=1024&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]said the bill
creates a sector-wide council for fast food workers to have a say in the
industry statewide — and hold corporations accountable
This fight is personal for Ash, whose uncle came from India and was
exploited by Jack-in-the-Box. “It turns out, they were paying him in gift
cards,” he recounted.

“The workers who feed our families are called heroes but they’re treated
as expendable. That’s why we need AB 257. Let’s do all we can because this
is it, with the vote coming up, the time for this is now.”
★ ★ ★

Half a million California fast food workers are on the cusp of victory,
but they need our solidarity and activism!

If you’re in California, help us counter the fast food lobbyists in
Sacramento by calling your state senators to demand they publicly endorse
AB 257. It’s a quick action for a big impact — don’t worry, it’s easy and
there’s a script!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6280?t=1025&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]CALL YOUR SENATORS

★ ★ ★

Join Our Revolution for our next AB 257 strategy session, starting at 6:45
pm PT this Monday (Aug. 15) — going live shortly after our National
Organize-to-Win Call. We’ll be sharing our latest organizing tool - the
REACH App - which makes “friendbanking” a cinch!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6281?t=1026&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]RSVP

★ ★ ★

CALLING OUT CHUCK SCHUMER

BRING ANTITRUST BILLS TO A VOTE!

Our Revolution activists have been bird-dogging Senate Majority Leader
Chuck Schumer on two antitrust bills - which can PASS - and now he’s
agreed to bring them for a Senate vote in September.

The American Innovation and Choice Online Act and the Open App Markets Act
would enable fairer competition on platforms, and ban self-dealing.

Our members and activists have driven 1300 calls to senators, urging them
to Bust Big Tech’s monopoly power.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5728?t=1027&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]CALL YOUR SENATORS

★ ★ ★

As you know, Bernie Sanders founded Our Revolution six years ago to wage
the fight for our progressive policy solutions and elect allies to partner
with our movement for change.

Our Revolution is the largest progressive grassroots-funded organization
in the country — [ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1028&akid=3251%2E5885482%2Ep9PPr4 ]but we need to maximize our power to beat back the
big money dominating politics. Become a sustaining member TODAY.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

A SEAT AT THE TABLE FOR CA FAST FOOD WORKERS

We need YOU to stand up with fast-food workers and Our Revolution to
demand the CA State Senate pass AB-257 - The FAST Recovery Act. This bill

| | Dear Residents of New York’s 23rd Congressional District,

Most of you know me. You know my record and what I have accomplished for Western New York and the Southern Tier. Early voting starts today __in person__ , August 13th and goes through August 21st. I am humbly asking for you to vote for me to be your next Congressman for this community. We face many issues, from skyrocketing inflation, crime, and gas prices surging. I am not a politician, I am a businessman who knows how to solve problems, and fight the establishment.

I believe that my record of creating tens of thousands of jobs in the area, serving in the Army, and taking on the establishment makes me well equipped to be your voice in Washington.

I am self-funding my campaign for all good reasons including the fact that no one will own me, and I will be beholden only to the people of the 23rd District. You have my word, that when elected to Congress, I will be a full-time Congressman not beholden to donors and special interests. This is not about my ego; it is about giving back to the community that has allowed me to have great success as a businessman. Again, I am humbly asking for your vote.

You can find your early voting location here: **[https://www.voteearlyny.org](https://CarlPaladino.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3bf22d0f57d54fb47b0038eb8&id=09e7ce7506&e=7e49f828ab)**

Yours truly,
Carl Paladino,
Candidate for Congress NY-23

Peter,

These are dark times for our Nation, as my beautiful home, Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach, Florida, was raided, and occupied by a large group of FBI agents.

Nothing like this has ever happened to a President of the United States before, and it's important that you know that it wasn't just my home that was violated - _it was the home of every patriotic American who I have been fighting for since that iconic moment I came down the Golden Escalators in 2015._

**I stood up to the Radical Left's corruption. I restored power to the people and truly delivered for our Country like we have never seen before.__The establishment hated it.__**

| **Measure to legalize recreational marijuana cleared for Nov. 8 ballot**
Missouri voters this fall will decide whether to legalize recreational marijuana use after Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft on Aug. 9 certified an initiative petition placing the measure on the Nov. 8 statewide ballot. However, a separate initiative seeking to establish a new system for state and congressional elections failed to qualify.

The marijuana measure will appear on the ballot as Amendment 3. In addition to legalizing marijuana use for those age 21 and older, it also would provide for the regulation and licensing of marijuana producers and retailers, authorize the expungement of records of those convicted of certain marijuana offenses and impose a 6-percent tax on marijuana sales.

With 65.6 percent support, Missouri voters amended the state constitution in 2018 to legalize marijuana use for medicinal purposes. Amendment 3 is backed by the same group responsible for the prior amendment and would grant those holding licenses to produce or sell medical marijuana preference in receiving licenses for recreational production and sales.

To qualify for the ballot, an initiative petition proposing a constitutional amendment must have valid signatures from roughly 172,000 registered Missouri voters, as well as hit minimum signature marks in at least six of Missouri’s eight congressional districts. Amendment 3 had 214,535 valid signatures and hit the necessary mark in six districts.

The failed elections measure sought to establish “ranked-choice voting” when electing candidates for the state legislature, statewide executive branch offices or Congress. Such a system would allow Missourians to vote for multiple candidates for a particular office, ranked in order of preference. If a no candidate earned a majority on the initial count, the votes of the lowest performing candidates would be redistributed to the remaining candidates until a winner emerged. Ashcroft’s verification process concluded supporters submitted only 159,560 valid signatures and failed to hit the minimum mark in any congressional district.

| **FEDS intervene to reduce Medicaid application wait times**
The federal government has intervened to help Missouri’s Medicaid program reduce wait times for applicants seeking health care coverage, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported on Aug. 10. Under federal guidelines, wait times shouldn’t exceed 45 days but instead have surpassed
100 days in Missouri.

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services on July 11 approved a plan to assist Missouri in lowering application wait times, the paper reported. The plan sets a goal of achieving the federal standards by Sept. 30. The state could face federal sanctions if it misses the deadline, according to the paper.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=a791a72e9a&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

| **RX OUTREACH EXPANDS ELIGIBILITY **
Below is a memo from a trusted non-profit:

As a non-profit, mail-order pharmacy, Rx Outreach is uniquely positioned to help stop the spread of COVID-19 for people who are quarantined and those who may be afraid to travel outside of their homes to the clinic or pharmacy.

Rx Outreach lifted its income guidelines during this crisis so that **anyone, regardless of income, can participate in their program.**

Rx Outreach medication prices are generally 70-80% below retail and are transparent. Shipping is free.

Eli Lilly and Company has introduced a program to purchase Basaglar insulin at significant cost savings. With 65.6 percent support, Missouri voters amended the state constitution in 2018 to legalize marijuana use for medicinal purposes. Amendment 3 is backed by the same group responsible for the prior amendment and would grant those holding licenses to produce or sell medical marijuana preference in receiving licenses for recreational production and sales. To qualify for the ballot, an initiative petition proposing a constitutional amendment must have valid signatures from roughly 172,000 registered Missouri voters, as well as hit minimum signature marks in at least six of Missouri’s eight congressional districts. Amendment 3 had 214,535 valid signatures and hit the necessary mark in six districts. The failed elections measure sought to establish “ranked-choice voting” when electing candidates for the state legislature, statewide executive branch offices or Congress. Such a system would allow Missourians to vote for multiple candidates for a particular office, ranked in order of preference. If a no candidate earned a majority on the initial count, the votes of the lowest performing candidates would be redistributed to the remaining candidates until a winner emerged. Ashcroft’s verification process concluded supporters submitted only 159,560 valid signatures and failed to hit the minimum mark in any congressional district. | | FEDS intervene to reduce Medicaid application wait times The federal government has intervened to help Missouri’s Medicaid program reduce wait times for applicants seeking health care coverage, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported on Aug. 10. Under federal guidelines, wait times shouldn’t exceed 45 days but instead have surpassed 100 days in Missouri. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services on July 11 approved a plan to assist Missouri in lowering application wait times, the paper reported. The plan sets a goal of achieving the federal standards by Sept. 30. Free technical college, pay raises for teachers, Medicaid expansion,
building infrastructure and providing support for entrepreneurs and small
businesses. All of this without a single cent raised in taxes — using our
historic $5 billion budget surplus.

But I’ll give it to you straight: we’re in the fight of our lives right
now. We’re up against an incumbent governor who has shown time and again
he will wield the power of his office to advance voter suppression bills
to help him hold on to power and damage our democracy.

Because Brian Kemp only cares about helping out his rich friends while

He rolled back restrictions for weapons to be carried into public spaces

He has continually put money meant for rural revitalization in the pockets

And with Stacey as governor, Georgia Thrives.

All of this without a single cent raised in taxes — using our historic $5 billion budget surplus. But I’ll give it to you straight: we’re in the fight of our lives right now. We’re up against an incumbent governor who has shown time and again he will wield the power of his office to advance voter suppression bills to help him hold on to power and damage our democracy. [ ]But Derek, it costs a whole bunch of money to reach out to every corner of Georgia. The honest truth is we can’t spread Stacey’s message without grassroots supporters like you. Can I count on you to give your first contribution right now to spread Stacey’s message? [ ]DONATE “Our state thrives when opportunity is available for everyone.” This is Stacey’s vision. This is the vision of a true leader. This is a vision Brian Kemp will never support. Because Brian Kemp only cares about helping out his rich friends while making life harder for everyday Georgians. He rolled back restrictions for weapons to be carried into public spaces like schools, instead of providing schools with more funding and teachers with higher salaries. He has supported a 2021 law after Democrats won the runoffs that tries to disenfranchise voters of color because he knows in a fair fight, he would lose. He has continually put money meant for rural revitalization in the pockets of his rich friends. As Stacey told us Tuesday night: We are entitled to more. Our taxes have paid for more. And now it's time to get our money's worth. And we are pushing back with all our might against voter suppression. And with Stacey as governor, Georgia Thrives. But we can’t get there without you, plain and simple. [ ]So what do you say, Derek: can you chip in $5 to spread Stacey’s message and create a brighter future for all of Georgia? Let’s do this! body:
Rep Sarah Palin?!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Just when you think the Republican Party and American politics can't sink any lower, she's back.** **Sarah Palin.** The twice impeached Republican President--both times for betraying our national security--is being investigated under the Espionage Act for stealing classified documents and storing them among the bedbugs, sycophants and spies at Mar-a-Lago. So here comes Sarah Palin, who's run out of reality shows, cheap gimmicks and family values (her husband Todd divorced her a few years ago, accusing her of abuse), reentering a political system she helped debase in 2008 with her casual stupidity and endless conspiracies. [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T51613c75-8914-4596-b1bb-cfa5a6b611d9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **Palin's running for the vacant seat in Congress from Alaska. She was joined by Trump at a rally the very day Mar-a-Lago was raided, and put out the following crass, dishonest and riot-inciting statement (See FBI Building, Cincinnati) in response to the FBI raid to retrieve stolen state secrets----including some on nuclear technology--that Trump may have been selling to our enemies:** _**If Palin wins the seat from Alaska, she'll have the large soapbox afforded her by her fame from which to attack our democracy and institutions, weakening the rule of law. It would be like taking Marjorie Taylor Greene or Lauren Boebert and injecting them with steroids. In a few words, Sarah Palin's uniquely dangerous.**_ **Luckily we have a GREAT CHANCE to stop Palin and win this seat. Alaska has a top four primary and a ranked choice general election ballot. Native Alaskan and Democrat Mary Peltola is running for the seat, and if Democrats list her first, and she's listed second on enough ballots by independents and Republicans angry at the other Republicans for attacking their top choice, she can win!**

She has made sustainability a key part of her life and platform by directing the Kuskokwim River Inter Tribal Fish Commission representing more than 30 tribes working to restore salmon returns to their traditional spawning grounds. ** _Almost any human walking this Earth would be a huge upgrade over Sarah Palin, but with Peltola, we can bring diversity to Congress, add a terrific legislator and reject a dangerous demagogue who has proven in the past she'll tell any lie, smear any opponent--even putting them in danger as when she said then Senator Obama "palled around with terrorists"\--to get what she wants. Palin is like an out-of-date, crappy reality show that was cancelled a decade ago. Let's not bring that back into our lives and politics. _ [**Can you please join me in supporting Mary Peltola with $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford, and rejecting the hate and lies, once again, of Sarah Palin?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2f02c11c-d9db-4a43-a35d-a2e7c8e5cc37/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for helping us stop Sarah Palin from gaining power yet again. But if they think we’re going to roll over and let them get away with it, they’re wrong: The NDRC is launching a **NEW three-pronged strategy** to safeguard our democracy, beginning this election year and continuing _for as long as it takes_.

**#1: Elect pro-democracy candidates into office**
You already know about our work to elect Democracy Defenders who could be the last line of defense against the destruction of our democracy.

**#2: Preserve and expand access to voting**
As state legislatures try to curtail voting all over the country – and the Supreme Court lets them – a new push on voting freedom couldn’t be more urgent.

**#3: Protect election infrastructure and administration**
This means ensuring election deniers are unsuccessful in their efforts to corrupt the pool of election workers and infiltrate election administration from the inside.

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: The first time my grandmother cast a ballot.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek, I want to
share a story my grandmother told me — [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220813_B3_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1453%2E1862389%2EQ-kV0a ]that shows just how important it
is we have the resources to empower every single Georgian who wants to
cast their vote in this election.

The year was 1968 and my grandmother, born and raised in Mississippi, was
eligible to vote in a presidential election for the first time. For so
many Black voters in the South, this chance to cast a ballot was the
culmination of centuries of struggle.

Outfitted in his Sunday best, my grandfather called out for her to head to
the precinct. But my grandmother hesitated.

Why did she falter after such a long fight — after braving the dogs, the
hoses and the billy clubs?

She told me, "I wasn’t afraid of the right to vote — I was afraid of the
power." She was most afraid that she would finally be able to exercise
this fundamental right — one that she and so many others fought so hard
for — and that nothing would change.

Despite her fears, my grandmother voted that day. She voted because of the
people — including my parents — who had sacrificed their liberty and, for
some, their lives, to secure the possibility. And she never missed an
election after that.

Because she knew we can change our future through our vote. Our vote is
the most powerful tool we have to fight back against disenfranchisement in
our communities, against legislative barriers to progress like my
opponent’s voter suppression efforts and his extreme 6-week abortion ban.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220813_B3_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1453%2E1862389%2EQ-kV0a ]Derek, I am
fighting to make sure we remove the barriers people like my grandmother
and families all across Georgia face. And with less than 90 days until
Election Day, it’s more important than ever that we have the resources we
need to reach voters now. Will you make your
first investment in my
campaign today?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220813_B3_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=1453%2E1862389%2EQ-kV0a ]DONATE

My mission is to protect our right to vote so that our democracy reflects
the needs and ambitions of those it governs. My parents raised me to
believe the right to vote is sacred and that you work for it — and you
work to ensure everyone else can too.

Georgians are living in a state with a governor who is actively making it
harder for them to vote. Our opponents would rather make it harder for
Georgians to participate in our democratic process than to lose control.
But if we get to work together, we can change the future.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220813_B3_Grandmother_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=1453%2E1862389%2EQ-kV0a ]Our votes have immense power,
Derek, so let’s show the nation
we’re in this together and show our opponents that we’re ready for this
election. Will you contribute $5 now to our fight to open
the gates of opportunity for all Georgians?

We have the power to build a better Georgia — for ourselves, for our
grandparents and parents, for our children and their children.

Let’s meet this moment,
Derek.

Stacey Abrams
